commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.

90+2' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
90+1' The resulting corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
89' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Joan Garcia has no trouble gathering it.
88' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Girona earn a corner.
85' The referee blows his whistle after Pol Lozano (Espanyol) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
82' That will be all from Miguel Gutierrez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Silvi Clua Oya (Girona).
81' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Alvaro Tejero and he is replaced by Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
79' The ball is out of play and Espanyol manage to earn a corner.
78' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
78' Jofre (Espanyol) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
75' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Joan Garcia intercepts the ball.
75' Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
72' Jofre (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
72' Here is a change. Bryan Gil is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Arnaut Danjuma (Girona).
71' Substitution. Bojan Miovski makes way for Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
71' Javi Puado (Espanyol) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
67' Bryan Gil (Girona) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
65' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
64' Rafel Bauza comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol).
64' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Alejo Veliz is replaced by Irvin Cardona (Espanyol).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch for Sergi Gomez.
63' An attempted cross from Arnau Martinez (Girona) is cleared.
61' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) takes the free kick from long distance. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
60' The attendance for today's match is 12461.
60' Michel has decided to make a change. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) replaces Yaser Asprilla.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donny van de Beek trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
59' What a long-range shot by Yaser Asprilla (Girona). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.

55' 4 - 1 Jofre slides a pass towards Javi Puado (Espanyol) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom right corner. The score is now 4:1.
53' It looked like the long-range shot by Arnau Martinez (Girona) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
50' Donny van de Beek (Girona) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
48' CHANCE! Donny van de Beek finds Bojan Miovski (Girona) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
46' Jofre (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
46' Manolo Gonzalez makes a switch. Brian Olivan is coming on in place of Carlos Romero (Espanyol) at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) will take the corner.
45+3' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Yaser Asprilla (Girona) as his effort only hit the wall. Girona have been awarded a corner kick.

45+2' Alex Kral (Espanyol) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Girona earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Jofre (Espanyol) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
41' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sergi Gomez (Espanyol) but poses no threat.
40' Jofre (Espanyol) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
38' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
36' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
35' Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jofre (Espanyol).

33' Rafel Bauza (Espanyol) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
31' Javi Puado (Espanyol) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
31' Joan Garcia pulls off a great save to deny Donny van de Beek (Girona), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
30' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga comes off his line to gather the ball.
27' 4 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Ladislav Krejci (Girona) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Donny van de Beek knock down. 4:0.
27' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

27' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
24' Rafel Bauza (Espanyol) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
23' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
21' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Bryan Gil plays it into the box, and Bojan Miovski (Girona) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 3:0.
21' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' Sergi Gomez (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' 2 - 0 Goal! Bojan Miovski (Girona) scores after an assist by Bryan Gil that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
13' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
10' Bryan Gil (Girona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
7' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

4' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Bryan Gil (Girona) latches on to a precise through ball from Bojan Miovski before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:0.
